Ranked-choice voting, sometimes called “instant run-off voting,” allows voters to choose their candidates in order of preference, by marking candidates as their first, second, third and subsequent choices.  The Republican primary for Congressional District 2 did not have a majority winner on election night (the first-choice count) and went into ranked-choice voting rounds. The results shown in the colmn represent the first-choice totals.  The final, second round vote totals were: Dale John Crafts, 28,019 (57.99%) and Adrienne Bennett, 20,295 (42.01%).
